title: MultiTransport field acceptance record v0
description: One redacted record of a physical field test of one provider artifact on one device (MT-001, design only). Records are mutable evidence kept separately from the immutable manifest; they are keyed to the exact artifact SHA and are never inherited automatically by other binaries, devices or profiles. Only synthetic identifiers and numeric metrics — no owner configs, credentials, private URIs or raw logs. A record is syntax-checked here; whether a test actually happened as described is verified by the evidence process (owner review), not by this schema.

artifact_sha256.description: Evidence is valid only for the binary with this exact digest.

device_id.description: Synthetic device/stand identifier (e.g. NC-4210-LAB-01). No serial numbers, no private addresses.

metrics.description: Numeric redacted metrics only (e.g. vmhwm_kib, min_memavailable_kib, peak_rss_kb).
